description: This file implements the LuciBuildApi class, which provides methods to interact with the LUCI build service, including fetching build artifacts, preparing request headers, and downloading artifacts from Google Cloud Storage. It defines the class constructor, several API methods, and utilizes auxiliary JSON parsing and HTTP client functionalities.
